product_version: Current LangChain4j online documentation checked 2026-11-09; Spring Boot starter examples show 1.23.0-beta33, but this cheatsheet does not pin a library release
version_sensitive_claims: Q6: @V binds a template variable but is optional when Java parameter names are retained with -parameters; current Spring Boot/Quarkus integration generally does not require it. Checked AI Services and @V docs 2026-11-09.
Q7: AI Services can parse typed returns; prompting is default while JSON Schema support depends on model and configuration. Checked structured outputs docs 2026-11-09.

Q8-Q9: TokenWindowChatMemory requires TokenCountEstimator and evicts whole messages; a shared ChatMemory is unsafe for multiple users, absent @MemoryId defaults to default, concurrent same-ID calls can corrupt memory. Checked chat-memory and AI Services docs 2026-11-09.
Q15: Current docs show distinct Spring Boot 3.5+ and 4 starters and separate Quarkus extension. Checked Spring Boot and Quarkus docs 2026-11-09.

Q16-Q18: ChatModelListener support is model-implementation-specific; output guardrails are experimental in core AI Services, can retry/reprompt, and buffer stream output until validation. Checked observability and guardrails docs 2026-11-09.
staleness_risks: LangChain4j experimental guardrails, non-blocking APIs, starter artifact names and versions may change; verify against the dependency version in the target project.
Provider-specific tools, JSON Schema, token usage and listener support differ; common Java interfaces do not guarantee equal model behavior.
